resources.string: Talks only to your organisation\'s Gateway. Hardware-backed. Zero tracking.\nYour keys never leave your device.

Veilo Enterprise approves sign-ins for your organisation through its own Veilo Gateway server, with number matching and keys held in secure hardware. It also generates time-based (TOTP) and counter-based (HOTP) one-time passwords. It talks only to your organisation\'s Gateway — no Veilo account, no analytics, no tracking.
Notifies you when a sign-in waits for your approval. The notification says nothing about the sign-in; the details appear only in the app.
A sign-in is waiting for your approval. Open Veilo to see the number.

1. Join your organisation: scan the enrolment QR code your organisation gave you (+ on the main screen). The key is created in this phone's security hardware and never leaves it.

2. Approve sign-ins: when you sign in to the VPN or another system, the sign-in screen shows a number. Veilo shows a sign-in request (a notification if the app is closed); tap the same number. If you are not signing in, tap "Not me".

3. Sign in with a QR code: on a web page that offers "Veilo ile giriş", tap the QR icon at the top of the account list and scan the page's QR code. Check the application name and the computer's address on the phone, then approve. You never type a code.

4. Codes: one-time codes still appear on the main screen; tap to reveal and copy.

5. Other accounts: you can add personal accounts with + as usual. Organisation accounts are never included in backups or transfers to another phone; a new phone is enrolled again by your organisation.

6. Lock: the app locks automatically when you leave it. Unlock with your biometric or device PIN.

• Organisation keys created in the phone's security hardware (StrongBox when available) and proven to the Gateway by hardware attestation
• Network access only to your organisation's Gateway, over TLS (with the certificate pins from the enrolment QR code when your organisation sets them)
• Every request signed by the device key; number matching against relayed sign-ins
• Notifications carry nothing about the sign-in; the details are fetched by the app
• Biometric or device credential required to unlock
• Screen capture and app-switcher preview blocked
• Copied codes cleared from clipboard in 30 seconds
• Root and debugger detection at launch
• No analytics, no tracking, no Veilo account
• Organisation accounts never exported: not in backups, PDFs or phone-to-phone transfers
• Android cloud backup and system device-to-device copy disabled
Veilo Enterprise is part of the Veilo Technology ecosystem — a suite of self-hosted, zero-trust enterprise security products.
